_about: Which facts a ship carries in the Lexicon, their type and unit, which sources are authoritative (most authoritative first), and how long a checked value stays fresh. Format: Project-Sophos sophos/src/lexicon/packs.mjs (validatePack, checkStatement). Rules for how a value is sourced and what status it may carry: assets/data/entities/README.md. Tekton itw-c1-cruise-pack-schema. Soli Deo Gloria.

identity.key: ship:<slug>, where <slug> is the In the Wake ship page slug; when two ships share a name, each takes the year it entered service as a suffix (ship:legend-of-the-seas-1995). The rule is decided per case in the entity file, never by renaming a page.

source_kinds.line-official: the cruise line's own ship page or fact sheet, read in the session; evidence tier primary
source_kinds.trade-press: a contemporary trade press source (Cruise Critic, Cruise Hive, Cruzely, Eat Sleep Cruise); evidence tier secondary
source_kinds.itw-data: a data file already in this repository; evidence tier secondary
